summary: Russian forces launched massive Shahed drone waves from Chernihiv and other regions targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Cherkasy, and other oblasts, alongside ballistic missile strikes on Smila and Kharkiv. Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge with at least four cruise missiles and hit an oil refinery in Azov, Rostov region, causing explosions and traffic restrictions. Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv regions, while search operations in Komyshuvakha confirmed 72 killed from a November 2 strike.
key_points: Over 25 Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district in multiple waves overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78360)
Ballistic missile strike hit Smila, Cherkasy region, near Shevchenkove/Poshtovy area. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78344)
Reactive Shahed drones targeted Troieshchyna (Kyiv), Vyshhorod, Rivne, Kryvyi Rih, Zaporizhzhia simultaneously. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78354)
Ukrainian strikes damaged Crimean Bridge with four cruise missiles and hit Azov oil refinery in Rostov region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85327)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia and southern Kharkiv regions. (Source: @kpszsu/96727)
Search operations in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, concluded with 72 confirmed dead from November 2 Russian strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/85347)
Russia receiving dozens of ballistic missiles monthly from North Korea, per Zelensky warning of massive attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/85346)
EU approved nearly €8 billion for Ukraine under Ukraine Facility after reform milestones. (Source: @UkraineNow/85335)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched massive Shahed drone waves from Chernihiv and other regions targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Cherkasy, and other oblasts, alongside ballistic missile strikes on Smila and Kharkiv. Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge with at least four cruise missiles and hit an oil refinery in Azov, Rostov region, causing explosions and traffic restrictions. Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv regions, while search operations in Komyshuvakha confirmed 72 killed from a November 2 strike.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted a strike on the Crimean Bridge using at least four cruise missiles, causing explosions that blew out windows in nearby buildings and halting traffic until at least noon, per occupation authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85327, @eRadarrua/131202)
A Ukrainian drone strike targeted the Azov oil refinery in Rostov region overnight, adding to deep-strike capabilities against Russian energy infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/85327)

Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple Shahed and reactive Shahed drones across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Khmelnytskyi regions overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78360, @mon1tor_ua/78354)

A Ukrainian serviceman threw a grenade during a conflict in Malaya Berezanka, Kyiv region, killing four people including himself, his mother, a 17-year-old girl, and her mother. (Source: @UkraineNow/85343)
The EU disbursed nearly €8 billion to Ukraine under the Ukraine Facility after Kyiv fulfilled over 20 reform steps in judiciary, anti-corruption, and financial markets. (Source: @UkraineNow/85335)

Russian forces launched over 25 Shahed-136/131 drones from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district in multiple waves, with additional groups from Zhytomyr targeting Rivne and Khmelnytskyi energy infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78360, @mon1tor_ua/78355)

Ballistic missiles fired from Taganrog, Rostov region, struck Smila in Cherkasy region and targeted Kharkiv/Zmiiv area, while a cruise missile (Banderyol) entered Poltava airspace heading toward Podilsk district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78341, @mon1tor_ua/78344, @mon1tor_ua/78321)

Reactive (jet-powered) Shahed drones simultaneously targeted Troieshchyna (Kyiv), Vyshhorod, Rivne, Kryvyi Rih, Zaporizhzhia, Chortkiv, and Teofipol, indicating expanded use of high-speed variants. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78354, @mon1tor_ua/78357, @mon1tor_ua/78356)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs (KABs) against Zaporizhzhia region and southern Kharkiv region, continuing glide bomb campaign against front-line oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/96727, @kpszsu/96734)

President Zelensky stated Russia is receiving dozens of ballistic missiles monthly from North Korea, with intelligence warning of new massive strikes on energy infrastructure this winter. (Source: @UkraineNow/85346, @UkraineNow/85334)
Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure raise risks of nuclear accidents at NPPs due to loss of off-site power for cooling, per regulators from 38 countries. (Source: @UkraineNow/85351)

Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia region, while a November 2 strike on Komyshuvakha killed 72 civilians with four still missing after two-week search operations. (Source: @kpszsu/96727, @UkraineNow/85347)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided bombs on southern Kharkiv region, and ballistic missiles targeted Kharkiv/Zmiiv area, maintaining pressure on northeastern front. (Source: @kpszsu/96734, @mon1tor_ua/78345)

Reactive Shahed drones circled over Zaporizhzhia city and targeted the area from Donetsk region, indicating persistent aerial harassment of eastern regional centers. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78354, @mon1tor_ua/78355)
Russian forces launched a Geran-5 rocket from Belgorod region toward Bohodukhiv district in Kharkiv region, adding to missile threat on eastern oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78354)

Over 25 Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district in multiple waves, with additional drones from Chernihiv targeting Nizhyn and Pryluky. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78360, @mon1tor_ua/78348)

Reactive Shahed drones from Chernihiv region targeted Kyiv region (Zhurivka) and Zhytomyr region (Korosten), while a Geran-5 rocket from Belgorod headed toward Pryluky/Nizhyn. (Source: @eRadarrua/131207, @mon1tor_ua/78348)

Ukrainian air defense engaged drones entering from Belarus airspace near Chornobyl exclusion zone, with Belarus scrambling tactical aviation toward Mazyr fearing Russian drones. (Source: @kpszsu/96712, @eRadarrua/131215)
Multiple drone groups detected over Chernihiv region moving toward Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions, including 18 UAVs via Ovruch toward Korosten. (Source: @eRadarrua/131214, @eRadarrua/131218)

Ukrainian forces struck the Crimean Bridge with at least four cruise missiles, causing explosions that shattered windows in nearby buildings and halting traffic for hours. (Source: @UkraineNow/85327, @eRadarrua/131202)
A Ukrainian drone strike hit the Azov oil refinery in Rostov region overnight, demonstrating extended reach against Russian energy infrastructure near the Sea of Azov. (Source: @UkraineNow/85327)

At least 15 Russian drones approached Vilkove, Odesa region, from the Black Sea, while a reactive Shahed from Mykolaiv region targeted Odesa en route to Vinnytsia. (Source: @eRadarrua/131144, @mon1tor_ua/78355)
Russian drones launched from occupied Crimea and southern areas continue to threaten Odesa and Mykolaiv regions with Shahed and reactive variants. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78355, @eRadarrua/131145)
